text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 53-55 Innes Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (September 15, 2020) for 53 to 55 Innes Avenue, Folder No. 20 193585 PRS 00 IV. 2. Directed the Municipal Standards Officer to review the site to ensure safe and secure conditions and advise the Owner accordingly.
